descriptionHtml:
Lexar NS100 256GB 2.5-Inch SATA III (6Gb/s) Internal Solid State Drive (Up to 520MB/s Sequential Read Speed / Shock and Vibration Resistant / 1-Year Store Warranty)

Upgrade your existing desktop or laptop system with the Lexar NS100 256GB 2.5-inch SATA III (6Gb/s) solid-state drive, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year store warranty. Designed to give your computer faster boot-ups, quicker application loading times, and improved overall system responsiveness, the NS100 SSD replaces traditional hard drives with reliable performance reaching sequential read speeds of up to 520MB/s. Built with durable solid-state design with no moving parts, it is cooler, quieter, and more resistant to shocks and vibrations than a standard hard drive.
